emulate.downgrade: Sent with normal priority instead of {priority}: alarms are switched off for this client (--max-priority {cap}), as they would ring through the user's quiet hours. Tell the user that it went out as an ordinary notification.
emulate.refused: Priority {priority} is switched off for this client (--max-priority {cap}): it would ring through the user's quiet hours. Send it again with normal priority, and tell the user that it went out as an ordinary notification, because alarms are switched off here.

instructions: Sends push notifications to the user's own phone and other devices through Pushover; it reaches nobody else. send_notification needs only message; leave out every other parameter the user does not ask for. Without device a notification reaches all of the user's devices, the phone included. Priority high is for something important or urgent; emergency only for an alarm the user wants repeated until acknowledged; low for no sound and no vibration; silent for no alert at all. For vibration alone use the sound vibrate. A sound the user names that is not among the built-in names of the sound parameter, such as a gong or a sound of their own, is one of the account's own: call list_sounds and take its name. Pushover cannot schedule: every notification goes out at once.

send_notification.description: Send a push notification to the user's own devices now; it cannot reach other people. Only message is required. Returns the request ID.
